name: versionlens-redux
description: Shows the latest version of each dependency, update actions, and known vulnerabilities in manifest files
author: Peter Flannery

versionlens.enabled.description: Show versions and vulnerabilities at all.

versionlens.codeLens.description: Show update actions as code lenses above each dependency.

versionlens.inlayHints.description: Show the newest version as an inlay hint after each dependency.

versionlens.vulnerabilities.description: Check versions against OSV.dev and report known vulnerabilities as warnings.

versionlens.timeoutMs.description: How long one registry request may take, in milliseconds.

versionlens.concurrency.description: How many registry requests run at once.

versionlens.cacheMinutes.description: How long registry answers are reused, in minutes.

versionlens.strictSsl.description: Reject registries whose TLS certificate does not verify.

versionlens.githubToken.description: GitHub token for GitHub tag lookups (Actions, Swift, CMake). Falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN.

versionlens.registries.markdownDescription: URL template per registry id, for mirrors and private registries, such as `{"npm": "https://npm.example.com/{enc}"}`.

versionlens.serverPath.description: Path to a versionlens-lsp binary to use instead of the bundled one. VERSIONLENS_LSP takes precedence.

versionlens.trace.server.description: Log the LSP traffic to the output channel.
